name: DeenOne Bangla Quran Official API
description: Ultra-fast, globally edge-cached static REST API for the Holy Quran with Arabic text, Bangla translation, audio streams, and Bangla Tafsir.

endpoints.name: All Surahs List
endpoints.description: Returns the complete list of 114 Surahs with metadata and audio links.

endpoints.name: Surah Details & Ayahs
endpoints.description: Returns all ayahs for the requested surah (1 to 114) with Arabic text, Bengali translation, and ayah audio URLs.

endpoints.name: Surah Bangla Tafsir
endpoints.description: Returns Bengali Tafsir (Abu Bakr Zakaria) mapped by ayah number.
